scope: Audit context for the currently exported fixed profiles and conditional Chapter keywords. Every prepared match with current-reference Marine profiles resolves their Chapter context, removes source-projected DEATHWING/RAVENWING from shared instances, then applies Dark Angels DEATHWING to TERMINATOR/DREADNOUGHT families and listed identities and RAVENWING to MOUNTED/VEHICLE+FLY families, including when optional unit abilities are off. Exported faction keywords remain runtime identity tags and are excluded from non-faction datasheet keyword comparison.
